items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I played with John Lewis, played with John Lewis, a ticket seat. So Kid René got me to play with him.

ctx.x: A 15 key Albert? Yeah, 15 keys, yes.

Uh-huh. Yeah, well, that's what I had when I bought from this gentleman, the month of December, when I bought it from him. It was a 15 key Albert. I kept it a pretty good while. And somehow or another, I don't know what happened, if I lost it, I can't remember. But John Lewis, while playing, you know, John Lewis loaned me a clarinet once. A silver clarinet. Oh, yeah. And I played that thing, I mean, for a good while. And so, I'm finished telling you, when I got to playing that music good, you know, and well, I…
